boards.name: AM HATSU
boards.description: Wireless split ergonomic board, 4x6 layout, BLE 5.0, two 5,000 mAh batteries, 3 W Qi charging. 3D-curved metal halves, combined weight 1.54 kg. Two supported layers, white PCB lighting, proprietary low-frequency inter-half link.

evidence: Official 4x6 / 45% split ortho description. Scene uses two 4x6 1u halves with a gap; not manufacturer CAD, tent angle, or half footprint.

boards.notes: HATSU-to-CYBERMAT R2 compatibility is official (ten central coils designed for HATSU). Qi placement unverified without footprint.

boards.name: CYBERBOARD R2
boards.description: 75%-class board with 5 x 40 LED panel, 200 screen LEDs + 81 in-switch LEDs, BLE 5.0 + USB-C, Qi charging, 10-degree typing incline, gasket mount, hot-swap. Manual confirms R2/R3 shared controls.

evidence: Official 5x40 / 200-LED panel count. Scene keeps a generic 75% key grid and adds an illustrative panel; exterior dimensions and LED pitch unpublished.

boards.notes: 40x5 RGB matrix is demonstrable; case silhouette must remain approximate until licensed dimensioned source appears.

boards.name: AM AFA R2

evidence: No CAD or measurement published for this model.

boards.name: AM Relic 80

boards.name: CYBERBOARD R3

evidence: No official CAD or dimensions published; R3 manual shared with R2.

boards.name: CYBERBOARD Terminal
boards.description: 75% retro-futuristic RGB; translucent integrated gasket mount; mirror-PVD stainless weight. Engraved bundle $810 / base kit $528; both sold out.

evidence: No CAD published; distinctive retro-futuristic profile.

boards.name: AM Neon 80
boards.description: 80% synthwave design, four-dimensional RGB matrix lighting, three-stage leaf spring. Product page current; no verified price.

boards.name: AM RGB 65 R1.5
boards.description: 65% Game Boy-inspired DIY LED panel, adjustable leaf-spring mount. Limited / sold out variants; from $435 (regular $451).

boards.name: the Seneca
boards.description: Electrocapacitive board sold as the First Edition. Plasma-ceramic finished aluminium in Oxide Gray, Travertine or Heatshield, or bead-blasted Veracity Titanium, with a thick solid brass switch plate in matte silver chrome. Ships with an MTNU-profile R&D 1973 double-shot PBT set moulded by GMK. Designed for a flat typing position; an optional CNC walnut riser adds a 3 degree pitch.

offers.configuration: First Edition, lowest listed configuration of a $3,900-$8,900 range

evidence: No CAD or dimensioned drawing published; the listing describes finishes and materials only.

boards.notes: The listing publishes only the endpoints of its price range, so the lowest is recorded and the configuration reaching $8,900 is not attributed here. Sold out for immediate shipment: a 10 percent nonrefundable deposit reserves a build slot, and the listing states a nine-month queue estimate.

boards.name: Sonnet
boards.description: 75% kit measuring 315 x 143 mm with a 19 mm front height, 24 mm back height and 5.5 degree typing angle, assembling to 4-7.5 lb. Media-blasted aluminium top and bottom with a maple accent and a stainless steel weight. The base kit is the case, PCB and daughterboard, mounting system, feet and fasteners; switches, keycaps and stabilisers are bought separately. QMK/VIA ARM PCB for 80-83 MX-style switches.

offers.configuration: Base kit, before edition, PCB and plate options

evidence: Case measurements are published, but no CAD or plate/PCB geometry is.

boards.notes: Priced from $289 with per-option costs added at build time (edition +$30 or +$40, hot-swap PCB +$5, plate +$10 to +$40), so an assembled price depends on choices not recorded here. Black Sesame, Forest Mocha and Steel Mushroom editions were sold out when observed.

boards.name: Encore
boards.description: 65% kit measuring 326 x 125 mm with a 12.5 mm front height (19.7 mm at the chamfer) and a 5.5 degree typing angle, assembling to 2.9-3.2 lb. Crown mounting system, with a media-blasted maple or aluminium top over a media-blasted aluminium middle and bottom on silicone feet. The base kit is the chassis, PCB and daughterboard, mounting system, feet, fasteners, assembly tools and a microsuede bag; switches, keycaps and stabilisers are bought separately. QMK/VIA ARM PCB for 66-68 MX-style switches over USB-C, designed by Gondolindrim.

offers.configuration: Base kit, before plate, switch, stabiliser and keycap options

evidence: Case measurements and typing angle are published, but no CAD or plate/PCB geometry is.

boards.notes: Priced from $299 with options added at build time (carbon fibre or aluminium plate +$10, copper +$40, switches $42 to $50, stabilisers $15, keycaps $59.99), so an assembled price depends on choices not recorded here. Only the Studio Light edition was orderable when observed; Black Sesame, Matcha Cream, Mocha Mushroom and Monterey Dune were sold out, as were the POM plate and the Obscura Linear switches.

boards.name: Chimera65 Round 2
boards.description: 65% kit designed by UPAS and produced with the manufacturer Hongtu, built from seven CNC case parts (top, bottom, weight, back accent, bottom accent, badge and plate) on a Poron gasket isolation sandwich mount. 7.5 degree typing angle, 10.86 mm ledge front height and 17.86 mm front height excluding the ledge; built weight is 1.0 kg in polycarbonate, 2.0 kg for the aluminium Standard edition and 2.2 kg for the Special edition. QMK/VIA STM32 PCB in solder or hot-swap form with a C4 unified daughterboard, shipping with a universal ISO-compatible plate, an aluminium Chimera keycap, carrying case and authenticity card. Switches, keycaps and stabilisers are bought separately.

offers.configuration: Listed price before edition, PCB and stock-grade selection

evidence: Typing angle, front heights and built weights are published; case footprint and plate/PCB geometry are not.

boards.notes: Sold as one listing across eleven colourways in five editions (Standard, PC, E-White, Special and Legendary) and three stock grades, so the single listed price is recorded rather than a per-edition price. The same page still carries provisional group-buy pricing from the 2023 round ($450 Standard, $470 PC and E-White, $630 Special); that is not the current listed price and is not recorded as an offer. Stock was limited when observed. CannonKeys names this and the Satisfaction75 as its premium line, above the Brutal series.
